{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored trousers, high-waisted, straight cut, full length, deep charcoal (#36454F), wool crepe
Blouse, softly tailored with a pointed collar and concealed placket, long sleeves, ivory (#F2EBDD), matte silk
Cardigan-style jacket, fitted and collarless, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D2433), fine bouclé wool
Pointed-toe block-heel pumps, low heel, black (#1C1C1C), smooth leather
Structured top-handle bag, small, black (#1C1C1C), smooth leather
Thin silk scarf, knotted loosely at the neck, burgundy and ivory print (#6D2433 and #F2EBDD), silk twill
Long wool coat, single-breasted, knee-to-calf length, camel (#B98E5E), brushed wool

This outfit suits a classic, understated evening at the theatre in autumn. The tailored trousers, silk blouse and textured jacket give a polished neat look without being showy. Deep burgundy adds a quiet richness under artificial light, while the ivory near the face keeps it fresh. The low block heel stays comfortable through a 19:00 performance and the coat keeps the cool autumn evening at bay."}
